title: Virtuous leadership, trust in leader, and work-related well-being
descriptions: This dataset presents statistical data on virtuous leadership, trust in leader, and work-related well-being. The dataset contains data of 1237 respondents who were registered as having a full-time or part-time job and a direct supervisor in a multitude of organizations across various sectors in primarily the United Kingdom (UK) and the United States (US). Respondents were recruited through the online crowdsourcing platform Prolific. The surveys were completed in January 2019.
